definitions.gloss: to be surprised, to be astonished
definitions.explanation: To experience a sudden feeling of wonder or shock due to something unexpected.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised by the news.
examples.notes: に marks the cause of surprise

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{驚|おどろ}きました。
examples.english: I was astonished by his success.

examples.japanese: {驚|おどろ}く⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦{安|やす}かった→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.notes: {驚|おどろ}くほど = to a surprising degree

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {驚|おどろ}かす (transitive, to surprise someone). Pattern: Xに{驚|おどろ}く (be surprised at X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {驚|おどろ}いている = 'is surprised' (in a state of surprise).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・Xに{驚|おどろ}く (be surprised at X)
・{驚|おどろ}くほど (surprisingly, to a surprising degree)
・{驚|おどろ}くべき (surprising, astonishing—attributive)
・{驚|おどろ}いたことに (to my surprise)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・びっくりする: more casual, sudden surprise
・{驚|おどろ}く: general surprise/astonishment
・{仰天|ぎょうてん}する: extreme shock (more dramatic)
